content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.rationale: A full-text search for "insurance" returns no hits, and a read of all 75 paragraphs (including the General Provisions in Section 14(a)–(i)) confirms the Agreement contains no insurance covenant of any kind — no CGL, no professional/tech E&O, no cyber, no workers' compensation, and no certificate requirement. This is a services/hosting arrangement where Kubient hosts the Auction Platform and, per Section 9(b)(iii), collects, maintains, manages and stores visitor information (data), and per Section 3(g) receives Requests (data sent from Customer). A vendor that processes such data with zero required coverage falls into the rule's walk-away territory rather than the fallback (which still requires E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M), so the omission is material notwithstanding the rule's low severity. Kubient's broad indemnity in Section 10(a) is unbacked by any solvency assurance, which is precisely the gap insurance addresses. Remedy: insert a short covenant as new Section 14(j) at the preferred position — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where Kubient handles Customer/visitor data, workers' compensation as required by Law, and certificates on request, maintained through the Term and one year thereafter. The fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is available in negotiation if Kubient's existing program is more modest.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant as new General Provisions subsection (j)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant, as Kubient collects and stores visitor data under Section 9(b)(iii) and the Agreement currently requires no coverage at all. Our position is CGL of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M and cyber liability of USD 5M with certificates on request; we can discuss lower cyber and E&O limits if Kubient's current program is more modest.

ops.text: Kubient shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the Term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, where Kubient collects, processes or stores Customer data or visitor data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. Kubient shall also maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law. Kubient shall provide certificates of insurance to Customer on request.
